ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with a low macro-level ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels, approximately 10-15% white to 85-90% black.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark pigmentation base across both lobes with high-frequency, small-scale white circular and irregular blobs (mottling) distributed across the visible surface, with higher density clusters near the distal tips and trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and serrated boundary with frequent peaks and valleys of varying pixel-amplitude across the entire trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the median notch extending to pointed lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous localized circular white pixel clusters, consistent with barnacle attachment sites, concentrated along the trailing edges and both terminal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, non-parallel vertical and diagonal linear white disruptions (rake marks) visible primarily on the surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable jagged irregular notches along the trailing edge and visible calcified deposits/barnacle colonization at the extreme distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique stippled pattern of high-contrast white dots across a solid black fluke surface.
